description: Dependency-free CSV implementation of IImportFileParser used to power the parse step of TmImportWizard. Performs RFC-4180-ish parsing: quoted fields, embedded delimiters, embedded newlines, escaped quotes (""), and CR/LF/CRLF line endings. Reads UTF-8 and strips a leading BOM. Rows are normalised to a rectangular shape by padding shorter records to the widest column count.

members.name: ParseAsync
members.description: Reads the stream as UTF-8 (BOM stripped) and parses its contents into detected columns and raw string rows.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Readable stream of the uploaded file's bytes.

parameters.name: ct
parameters.description: Token used to cancel the operation.

members.name: Parse
members.description: Static helper that parses already-loaded CSV text using the given options.
